name: Parallel processing
description: Many cores and many waits: parallel groups, channels, streams with back-pressure, tasks in a job (`async`, `spawn`, `await`), deadlines and cancellation, and region memory. Generics for classes, traits and abstract classes also arrive here. The results of parallel code must be deterministic: it is

features.name: Logging and observability
features.summary: Structured logs, job events, run reports, trace ids.

features.name: Testing module `test`
features.summary: Checks that print ok/FAIL, counters, summary that raises.

features.name: Traits, abstract classes, generics
features.summary: trait, required methods, abstract classes, class Name(:T) with Box(:Integer)(5), constraints (:T <: Comparable), library traits Iterable, Stream, Comparable, Printable.

features.name: Stream type
features.summary: Stream(:T) <: Iterable(:T), read by for with back-pressure; at level 4 Channel(:T) is the stream, and lists get batch(n) and split(k).

features.name: `Atomic(:T)`
features.summary: A class of the standard library that wraps the atomic of the machine, for Logic, numbers, references and ordinals; class Name <: Atomic(:T).

features.name: Parallel aspects
features.summary: parallel … do start … done, barrier, data rules, errors as a job.

features.name: Worker pool and scheduler
features.summary: $cores, M:N, a waiting aspect gives its core away.

features.name: Channels
features.summary: Channel(:T), send, receive, close, pipelines, deadlock detection, time-out.

features.name: Tasks in a job
features.summary: async subprograms, spawn, await; the tasks of a job share its core.

features.name: Deadlines and cancellation
features.summary: Per-group time limits, cancel or collect errors.

features.name: Multitasking semantics
features.summary: semantics/multitasking.md: parallel groups, channels, tasks in a job, durations, determinism.

features.name: Debugger
features.summary: Debug mode, halt breakpoints, step, print variables, reports.

features.name: Editor support
features.summary: Syntax colors for VS Code and GitHub, then a language server.

features.name: Region memory
features.summary: Arena per aspect call, job and request; long-lived heap for modules and channels.
